commands.name: simple
commands.description: Turn Clean View on or off (no argument flips it)

tools.name: plan_steps
tools.description: Lay out every step of the job up front, before any other tool: 2 to 8 short plain-English step names in order, each under 40 characters and starting with a verb. No file paths, file names, commands, code or tool names. The first step starts right away.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Report real progress on the current step. Use the step name exactly as planned; percent 0 to 100, and 100 the moment the step is finished, which starts the next one. A new plain-English name adds a step.
